description: Run a Jandy AquaLink RS panel’s variable-speed pump at one of its named speeds (from iaqualink_list_pump_speeds), through WebTouch — the panel makes a pressed speed the running speed at once. Nothing is pressed if that speed already runs; the speeds are re-read afterwards to confirm. Switch back the same way. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

speed.description: A named speed as iaqualink_list_pump_speeds shows it, e.g. "Pool" or "Spa"

name: iaqualink_set_pump_speed
